Senior AV Simulation Engineer — Autonomous Driving
Santa Clara, CA / Remote

Who we are:
We build the simulation stack that validates perception and planning for
autonomous driving at scale.

What you'll do:
- Develop scenario-based testing pipelines that replay real driving logs.
- Scale log replay and resimulation across a distributed compute fleet.
- Integrate perception models and evaluate against ground truth.

Requirements:
- Expert Python and strong C++ for high-performance simulation.
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
- Comfort with Docker-based reproducible environments.
- Deep understanding of perception (lidar, radar, camera) pipelines.

Nice to have:
- Familiarity with ONNX model export.
- Prior work with ROS2 middleware.
